bullets: Ultra-bright 25500 Lumen front and taillight combo Featuring a powerful 25500 Lumen output, this bicycle light delivers exceptional visibility for safe night riding on both mountain and road trails.
High-capacity 10000mAh rechargeable battery Equipped with a 10000mAh battery, this light ensures long-lasting performance, ideal for extended cycling sessions without frequent recharging.
Durable aluminum alloy body construction Built with a premium aluminum alloy body, this light offers superior durability, heat dissipation, and resistance to impact and harsh weather conditions.
USB rechargeable for convenient power-up Powered by a USB charging system, the light can be easily recharged using any standard USB power source, making it highly portable and user-friendly.

Secure handlebar mounting with adjustable fit Designed for handlebar mounting, this light provides a stable and adjustable installation, ensuring optimal beam direction and secure attachment during rides.
8LED design with integrated taillight The 8LED front light paired with a built-in taillight enhances visibility from all angles, improving safety for both day and night cycling.
Brand: VASTFIRE – Reliable performance Crafted by VASTFIRE, this high-performance lighting system combines advanced technology and reliable engineering for serious cyclists.
